passages.provision_quote: It is the policy of the state that eligible renewable energy resources and zero-carbon resources supply 90 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2035, 95 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2040, 100 percent of all retail sales of electricity to California end-use customers by December 31, 2045, and 100 percent of electricity procured to serve all state agencies by December 31, 2035.
passages.note: Laird authored SB 1020, which sets tiered mandatory RPS deadlines, matching rung 1's mandates-and-deadlines clause.

rows.reasoning: As author of SB 1020 (chaptered 2022, within his current term), Laird revised state energy policy to require eligible renewable and zero-carbon resources supply 90% of retail electricity sales by 2035, 95% by 2040, and 100% by 2045, with state agencies at 100% by 2035, replacing a single 2045 deadline with firmer interim mandates. This matches rung 1, "Require a shift to clean energy through mandates and firm deadlines," and excludes the subsidy, permitting-speedup, market-neutral, and deregulation clauses of the other rungs.
